stages.name: pre_due
stages.description: Friendly pre-due reminder sent 2 days before the invoice due date
stages.template: Hi {name}, friendly reminder that invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} is due on {due_date}. Early payment helps keep your credit terms active!

stages.name: due_day
stages.description: Due-day reminder sent on the exact due date
stages.template: Hi {name}, invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} is due today ({due_date}). Please process payment via UPI / Bank transfer.

stages.name: soft_followup
stages.template: Hi {name}, invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} was due on {due_date}. Please pay today to avoid credit hold.

stages.name: firm_followup
stages.description: Firm follow-up sent 7 days overdue, creates a salesperson case
stages.template: URGENT: Hi {name}, invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} is now 7 days overdue ({due_date}). Our sales manager {salesperson} has been assigned to assist you. Please reply PAID or PROMISE <date>.

stages.name: final_notice
stages.description: Final warning sent 15 days overdue, escalates case to manager
stages.template: FINAL NOTICE: Hi {name}, invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} is 15 days overdue ({due_date}). Credit services are suspended and your case is escalated to executive management.
